build_BasicEncoder: build a BasicEncoder feature extractor with configurable output_dim, norm_fn, and dropout for RAFT optical flow
build_SmallEncoder: build a SmallEncoder feature extractor using BottleneckBlock layers for lightweight RAFT optical flow encoding
create_ResidualBlock: create a ResidualBlock with configurable in_planes, planes, norm_fn, and stride for feature extraction
create_BottleneckBlock: create a BottleneckBlock with 1x1-3x3-1x1 conv pattern and configurable normalization for SmallEncoder layers
test_BasicEncoder_forward: test the BasicEncoder forward pass with a batch of RGB image tensors and verify output shape
